scenarios.name: Hide and restore a panel on the side-docked ribbon

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left
the user opens the direct panel selector
the user selects Modify in the panel selector
the Modify group disappears from the side-docked ribbon
the remaining ribbon groups reflow vertically
the panel selector remains open with Modify unchecked
the user selects Modify in the panel selector
the Modify group returns to the side-docked ribbon
the panel selector remains open with Modify checked
